headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of July 20, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 17.03% compared to SPY's 9.51%. This results in an average alpha of 7.51%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has achieved an impressive return of 48.88%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100,' has a return of 10.38%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. Outperforming SPY during this period highlights the portfolio's resilience amid potential market uncertainties. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
